waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: This planning application is related to a plant deck and UPS Battery storage on an external roof.

decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below: 

Walls: Brick to match existing.

Replacement Windows: uPVC.

Door: Metal with glazed insert.

Battery storage enclosures: Metal, medium grey and dark red finish.

Switch Room: Semi-gloss green glass-reinforced plastic
.
Structural platform: galvanized steel. 

Roof: mineral-finished self-adhesive bituminous capsheet. 
				
The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: External alterations to the roofs of the West Wing of the Tower and Lab Block including the partial replacement of failed roofing at 15th and 16th floor roof levels; installation of a structural steel frame platform at 15th floor roof level to accommodate one GRP enclosure to house two switch rooms and two steel enclosures to house UPS batteries; provision of cable containment at both 15th floor roof level and 16th floor plant room level, installation of an external riser to accommodate cabling routed along the building facade; replacement of existing glazed doors and windows on the west elevation at 15th floor level with new fire-rated windows and a solid door with a glazed panel, and infill of the remaining openings with brick.
subdivision_of_building:
- Tower and Laboratory Block – West Wing (15th and 16th Floor Levels): External roof areas.
- Tower and Laboratory Block – Installation of an external riser on the south-east façade.
